user.title: Connect your Xfinity box
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should connect to your Xfinity X1 box.

token.title: Paste a token
token.description: Sign in at remote.xfinity.com, open the browser dev tools console, run `localStorage.arToken`, and paste the value here.

pair_failed.title: Pairing didn't finish
pair_failed.description: Submit to get a new code and try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair your Xfinity box
reauth_confirm.description: Xfinity stopped accepting Home Assistant's token. Pair again to keep controlling the box.

error.pair_timeout: The code wasn't entered on the TV within 3 minutes.
error.pair_failed: Xfinity reported an error while pairing.

abort.already_configured: This Xfinity box is already set up.
abort.invalid_token: The token doesn't identify an Xfinity box.
abort.wrong_device: That pairing is for a different Xfinity box than this entry.

tune.name: Tune to channel
tune.description: Types a channel number on the Xfinity box.

send_text.name: Send text command
send_text.description: Sends a voice-style command, as if spoken into the voice remote.

text.name: Text
text.description: What you'd say, e.g. "watch ESPN" or "open Netflix".
